parameters.name: Mphi
parameters.description: Mass of the colored scalar phi (resonance) [GeV]

parameters.name: Mphitilde
parameters.description: Mass of the colored scalar phitilde [GeV]

parameters.name: MX
parameters.description: Mass of the colored vector X [GeV]

parameters.name: MphiSM
parameters.description: Mass of the color-singlet scalar phi (FCNC) [GeV]

parameters.name: Mchi
parameters.description: Mass of the invisible fermion chi [GeV]

parameters.name: MV
parameters.description: Mass of the color-singlet vector V (FCNC) [GeV]

parameters.name: a0FC
parameters.description: Scalar FCNC coupling a^0_FC (flavor matrix)

parameters.name: b0FC
parameters.description: Scalar FCNC coupling b^0_FC (flavor matrix, axial)

parameters.name: a1FC
parameters.description: Vector FCNC coupling a^1_FC (flavor matrix)

parameters.name: b1FC
parameters.description: Vector FCNC coupling b^1_FC (flavor matrix, axial)

parameters.name: aqSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phi coupling to down quarks a^q_SR (flavor matrix)

parameters.name: bqSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phi coupling to down quarks b^q_SR (flavor matrix, axial)

parameters.name: ahalfSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phi coupling to up quark and chi a^{1/2}_SR (flavor vector)

parameters.name: bhalfSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phi coupling to up quark and chi b^{1/2}_SR (flavor vector, axial)

parameters.name: aqtildeSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phitilde coupling to down and up quarks atilde^q_SR (flavor matrix)

parameters.name: bqtildeSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phitilde coupling to down and up quarks btilde^q_SR (flavor matrix, axial)

parameters.name: ahalftildeSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phitilde coupling to down quark and chi atilde^{1/2}_SR (flavor vector)

parameters.name: bhalftildeSR
parameters.description: Colored scalar phitilde coupling to down quark and chi btilde^{1/2}_SR (flavor vector, axial)

parameters.name: aqVR
parameters.description: Colored vector X coupling to down quarks a^q_VR (flavor matrix)

parameters.name: bqVR
parameters.description: Colored vector X coupling to down quarks b^q_VR (flavor matrix, axial)

parameters.name: ahalfVR
parameters.description: Colored vector X coupling to up quark and chi a^{1/2}_VR (flavor vector)

parameters.name: bhalfVR
parameters.description: Colored vector X coupling to up quark and chi b^{1/2}_VR (flavor vector, axial)

parameters.name: eps3
parameters.description: Levi-Civita tensor for color SU(3) fundamental indices

lagrangian_terms.name: LphiKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: 1/2 del[phi, mu] del[phi, mu] - 1/2 MphiSM^2 phi^2

lagrangian_terms.name: LVKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/4 FS[V, mu, nu] FS[V, mu, nu] + 1/2 MV^2 V[mu] V[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: Lphi3Kin
lagrangian_terms.expression: DC[phi3bar, mu] DC[phi3, mu] - Mphi^2 phi3bar phi3

lagrangian_terms.name: LphitildeKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: DC[phitildebar, mu] DC[phitilde, mu] - Mphitilde^2 phitildebar phitilde

lagrangian_terms.name: LXKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/2 FS[Xbar, mu, nu] FS[X, mu, nu] + MX^2 Xbar[mu] X[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: LintFCNCscalar
lagrangian_terms.expression: phi * (a0FC[ff1, ff2] * uqbar[ff1].uq[ff2] + b0FC[ff1, ff2] * uqbar[ff1].Ga[5].uq[ff2])

lagrangian_terms.name: LintFCNCvector
lagrangian_terms.expression: V[mu] * (a1FC[ff1, ff2] * uqbar[ff1].Ga[mu].uq[ff2] + b1FC[ff1, ff2] * uqbar[ff1].Ga[mu].Ga[5].uq[ff2])

lagrangian_terms.name: LintPhiDD
lagrangian_terms.expression: eps3[i, j, k] * phi3[i] * (aqSR[ff1, ff2] * CC[dqbar[ff1, j]].ProjP.dq[ff2, k] + bqSR[ff1, ff2] * CC[dqbar[ff1, j]].ProjM.dq[ff2, k])

lagrangian_terms.name: LintPhiUChi
lagrangian_terms.expression: phi3[i] * (ahalfSR[ff] * uqbar[ff, i].ProjP.chi + bhalfSR[ff] * uqbar[ff, i].ProjM.chi)

lagrangian_terms.name: LintPhiTildeDU
lagrangian_terms.expression: eps3[i, j, k] * phitilde[i] * (aqtildeSR[ff1, ff2] * CC[dqbar[ff1, j]].ProjP.uq[ff2, k] + bqtildeSR[ff1, ff2] * CC[dqbar[ff1, j]].ProjM.uq[ff2, k])

lagrangian_terms.name: LintPhiTildeDChi
lagrangian_terms.expression: phitilde[i] * (ahalftildeSR[ff] * dqbar[ff, i].ProjP.chi + bhalftildeSR[ff] * dqbar[ff, i].ProjM.chi)

lagrangian_terms.name: LintXDD
lagrangian_terms.expression: eps3[i, j, k] * X[mu, i] * (aqVR[ff1, ff2] * CC[dqbar[ff1, j]].Ga[mu].ProjP.dq[ff2, k] + bqVR[ff1, ff2] * CC[dqbar[ff1, j]].Ga[mu].ProjM.dq[ff2, k])

lagrangian_terms.name: LintXUChi
lagrangian_terms.expression: X[mu, i] * (ahalfVR[ff] * uqbar[ff, i].Ga[mu].ProjP.chi + bhalfVR[ff] * uqbar[ff, i].Ga[mu].ProjM.chi)

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: LphiKin + LchiKin + LVKin + Lphi3Kin + LphitildeKin + LXKin + LintFCNCscalar + HC[LintFCNCscalar] + LintFCNCvector + HC[LintFCNCvector] + LintPhiDD + HC[LintPhiDD] + LintPhiUChi + HC[LintPhiUChi] + LintPhiTildeDU + HC[LintPhiTildeDU] + LintPhiTildeDChi + HC[LintPhiTildeDChi] + LintXDD + HC[LintXDD] + LintXUChi + HC[LintXUChi]
